alex_sre: Quick broadcast: rolling KV-cache maintenance + new eviction policy rollout scheduled Thu 2026-06-10 02:00-04:00 UTC. This is a planned, staged operation across edge regions to reduce long-tail evictions and unify prefix TTL behavior.
alex_sre: Scope: all edge racks in us-east-1, eu-west-1, ap-southeast-1. We'll roll config `kvcache.eviction_policy=v2-unified` and run a controlled prefix prune for prefixes older than 30 days.
infra_bot: Event created: "kvcache-maint-and-policy-rollout" 2026-06-10T02:00Z (link: https://ops.internal/events/2026-kvcache-rollout).
toni_oncall: Ack. I'll be oncall that window. What are the main risk thresholds?
alex_sre: Primary risks: transient p95 latency increase from rewarm, short token-cost spike, and potential small increase in backend TTFB if many prefixes rehydrate simultaneously. Rollback triggers: infer.p95 > baseline*1.20 for 10m or route.5xx_rate +0.6% abs for 5m.
ben_eng: We'll add soft rewarm + per-AZ QPS caps. Plan is to run a staged canary, observe, then ramp. Canary: eu-west-1a + us-east-1b (label: region=canary-kv-v2). Start at 3% traffic.
sara_prod: Product note: prepare support template. We only notify Dedicated customers if >10% p95 increase sustained for 30m. Support blurb should include tenant id, affected routes, observed metrics and ETA.
opsbot: Config queued: "kvcache-policy-rollout@infra" scheduled 2026-06-10T01:55Z by alex_sre.
alex_sre: Runbook (short):
1) preflight checks at 01:20 UTC: alerting, infra health, synthetic smoke
2) enable canary route: `POST /infra-api/route-shift {"policy":"kvcache-rollout-hedge", "percent":3}`
3) apply config to canary racks: `infractl config apply kvcache.eviction_policy=v2-unified --selector region=eu-west-1a,group=canary-kv`
4) observe 20m (metrics: edge.kvcache.hit_ratio, infer.latency_p95, route.5xx_pct, infra.gpu.mem.free)
5) if stable ramp: 10% -> 40% -> 100% across regions with stage gates
6) run prefix prune job on each region with `kubectl create job prune-prefix --from=cronjob/kv-prefix-prune --namespace infra --env PREFIX_TTL=30d`
7) prewarm using `tools/soft_rewarm.py --workers 8 --max-qps 200 --jitter 60`
8) completion: revert toggles and mark event closed

alex_sre: Quick ops commands for rollback:
- stop rollout: `POST /infra-api/route-shift {"policy":"kvcache-rollout-hedge", "percent":0}`
- scale down prune: `kubectl scale cronjob kv-prefix-prune -n infra --replicas=0`
- revert policy: `infractl config set kvcache.eviction_policy=v1-stable`
toni_oncall: I'll add the canary racks to the SLO dashboard and create watch dashboards for edge.kvcache.canary.* and edge.kvcache.global.*. I'll also pre-create alert notes for quick acknowledgement.
ben_eng: Rewarm guidance: avoid thundering herd. We'll use per-prefix pacing and staggered workers. Example snippet: 
```
for p in $(shuf sample-prefixes.txt); do
  curl -sS "https://edge.internal/rewarm?prefix=$p" &
  sleep 0.15 # ~6.6 qps per worker
done
```
ben_eng: I'll drop the script in infra/tools/rewarm and add a `--dry-run` mode for preflight.
sara_prod: Also confirm: any Dedicated customers with strict latency SLAs in these regions? I'll pull tenant list and flag any with webinar/launch windows.
alex_sre: Good ask. I'll share a short list by EOD. If anyone flags a tenant we exclude them from canary/ramp until we coordinate.
opsbot: Reminder: update incident page at https://incident.internal/INC-2026-KV-ROLL.
toni_oncall: Who's shadowing the canary? I can if ben wants to run rewarm.
ben_eng: Please do. I'll be running rewarm and watching backend TTFB. We'll cap per-AZ QPS to 150 during first ramp and increase if metrics look stable.
toni_oncall: Preflight checklist I'll run at 01:30 UTC: 1) alerting smoke, 2) synthetic rewarm smoke 3) dashboard baselines recorded. I'll paste results here.
opsbot: Automated preflight report will be posted 01:40 UTC.
sara_prod: Support template (draft): "We are performing planned maintenance to improve cache stability in your region. You may see a small, temporary increase in latency while caches rewarm. If your service experiences degradation beyond X, please reply with tenant id and we'll prioritize." Will iterate and drop final here.
alex_sre: Final notes: keep communication in this thread during the window. If you want to shadow the canary DM me before 01:45 UTC. We'll aim for minimal impact and fast rollback if anything unexpected shows up. :thumbsup:
toni_oncall: Acknowledged. I'll be live in the channel.
opsbot: Event reminder will post 30m before the window.
ben_eng: One more: add a temporary metric to track rewarm progress: `edge.kvcache.rewarm_rate` so we can correlate to p95. I'll add it to the dashboard.
sara_prod: Thanks team. I'll prep support channels and standby.
alex_sre: Thanks all. See you in the window.
